refnamediv.refpurpose: Type for a list of points

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Points is the type used to store a list of points.
This type is taken as input of several functions, such as as contourArea for example.
A VecPoints object is not a Scilab matrix (it is a mlist), but its content can to be extracted with the extraction operator.

itemizedlist.member: Full extraction (:): it returns a Scilab 2xn matrix containing all the coordinates of the points.
Extraction with index (i): it returns the coordinates of a point stored at the given index (not yet available).
